what_happened.line: The committee began exploring whether to become a formal bylaw-based committee rather than an ad hoc one, and put it on November's agenda.
The chair will contact the planning board and another member to research how other Massachusetts towns structure their open space committees.
The town website's open space plan page was corrected to restore the state's three-year extension approval letter and action-plan table.
Meeting ran with a bare quorum of four of seven seated members.

why_it_matters: A shift from ad hoc to a bylaw-governed committee changes how the committee is created, who can serve, and how it answers to Town Meeting, not just how it runs day to day.
The open space plan's state extension keeps the town eligible for related state grant programs, so its accurate posting is a housekeeping fix that matters for later funding applications.
